name: a heel of black bread
look: Dense, dark and a day past fresh. It would stop a door or a hunger, not both.

eat.text: You chew through the bread. It fights back. You win, mostly.

name: a grey turnip
look: Gallowmere's finest. Grey, hard and faintly bitter, like the town.

eat.text: You gnaw the turnip raw. It tastes of mud and endurance.

name: a wrinkled apple
look: Last autumn's apple, soft and wrinkled, still sweet in the middle.

eat.text: Soft, sweet and a little boozy. The best thing you've eaten here.

name: a strip of salt fish
look: Dried, salted river fish, stiff as a plank.

eat.text: Salty enough to make your eyes water. You'll want an ale after that.

name: a wedge of hard cheese
look: A pale wedge with a dark rind and a smell that arrives before it does.

eat.text: Sharp, crumbly and far better than it smells. For a moment Gallowmere is bearable.

name: a bowl of Morda's stew
look: Brown, hot and thick, with lumps that might be mutton. Nobody asks.

eat.text: You spoon down the stew. Warmth spreads from your belly out. You stop wondering what the lumps were.

name: a mug of ale
look: Brown ale with a thin head, in a mug that has been washed at some point.

drink.text: You drink it down. Flat, warm and exactly what you needed.

name: a coil of rope
look: Thirty feet of hemp rope, stiff with tar. Good for climbing, binding or hanging.

actions.use: You test the rope with a hard tug. It'll hold. What for, you'll decide later.

name: a tin lamp
look: A dented tin lamp with a horn window. Takes oil.

actions.light: You light the lamp. A small yellow circle pushes the dark back an arm's length.

name: a flask of lamp oil
look: Lamp oil in a stoppered clay flask. Smells thin. Maud waters it, people say.

actions.smell: Thin and sharp. There's water in this, no question.

name: a tallow candle
look: A stubby tallow candle. Smoky, cheap, better than the dark.

actions.light: You light the candle. It smokes and sputters and gives you a little room to see.

name: a tinderbox
look: Flint, steel and dry tinder in a small tin box.

actions.use: Strike, spark, a curl of smoke. You could light anything now. Careful.

name: an empty sack
look: A rough hemp sack. Holds things. That's all you can say about it.

name: a roll of bandages
look: Clean linen boiled in vinegar. The temple's best seller.

use.text: You bind your wounds tight. It stings, then it's better.

name: a small knife
look: A plain knife with a wooden handle. For bread, rope and the odd argument. Wield it and it's a weapon.

actions.use: You cut a thread off your sleeve. Sharp enough.

name: a claw hammer
look: Hamo's work: a good iron head on an ash handle.

name: an iron crowbar
look: Three feet of iron with a hooked end. Opens crates, doors and conversations.

name: a roll of lockpicks
look: Slim steel picks in an oiled leather roll. Illegal to own. Very useful. Not yet.

actions.use: You practise on your own belt buckle. You're not good at this yet.

name: an oak cudgel
look: Knotted oak, heavier at one end. The dock bruisers swear by them.

name: a hatchet
look: A short axe with a bearded head. Splits kindling, and worse.

name: a short sword
look: A plain, honest blade, the best in town. Hamo won't say who else he's made them for.

name: a vial of holy water
look: River water, blessed by Father Osmund. He insists the river part doesn't matter.

drink.text: It tastes like river. You feel no holier. You feel slightly worse.

name: a string of prayer beads
look: Wooden beads on a cord, worn smooth by somebody else's worries.

actions.use: You count the beads. It helps less than you hoped, more than you expected.

name: a bent nail
look: A square iron nail, bent double. Hamo might take it for scrap.

name: a rusty buckle
look: A belt buckle rusted almost through. There's a faint crest on it, nobody's anymore.

name: a cracked mug
look: A clay mug with a crack down one side. Holds ale for about four seconds.

name: a stub of tallow
look: The end of somebody's candle. Still lights.

actions.light: It sputters into life, a thumb's worth of light.

name: a pair of bone dice
look: Carved bone dice, yellowed. One of them always comes up six. Funny that.

actions.use: You roll them. Six and six. You roll again. Six and six.

name: a rusty fish hook
look: A barbed iron hook. Mind your thumb.

name: a cork float
look: A net float, bleached by the river. Light as a promise.

name: a piece of river glass
look: Green glass worn smooth and cloudy by the river. Pretty, in a dull light.

name: an old coin
look: A heavy coin with a king nobody remembers. Gold, maybe, under the muck. Tilly or Hook would know.

name: a tin ring
look: A cheap ring with a glass stone. Someone was proposed to with this. It didn't go well.

name: a brass locket
look: A brass locket on a cracked chain. Inside, a painted face scratched out.

actions.open: It opens on a tiny face, scratched out with a pin. Somebody meant it.

name: a silver spoon
look: A real silver spoon with a monogram filed off. Somebody's grandmother is still looking for this.

name: a sack of Maud's turnips
look: A heavy sack of turnips with MAUD chalked on it. Give it to Maud for your pay.

name: a padded jerkin
look: Quilted wool stuffed with rags. It turns a glancing blow and smells of the last owner.

name: a leather coat
look: Boiled leather, stiff as a board, scarred where a blade found it once already.

name: a rat tail
look: Long, naked and pink. Maud pays for these; the rats eat her grain.

name: the rat king's knot
look: A knot of tails grown together, dried hard. Proof you killed the thing in the Nest. Hook will want it.

name: an iron key
look: Heavy, black and old, with a bit like a broken tooth. It smells of the sewers.

name: a bundle of rags
look: Grey, damp and best not examined closely.

name: an empty bottle
look: Green glass, a crack near the neck, a smell of cheap gin.

name: a soggy tract
look: A cheap printed sheet: THE CART COMES FOR THE WICKED. Someone has added: AND EVERYONE ELSE.

actions.read: THE CART COMES FOR THE WICKED. Below, in pencil: AND EVERYONE ELSE.

name: a gnawed bone
look: Gnawed clean. You decide not to wonder what it came from.

name: a pilgrim's token
look: A thin disc of fired clay stamped with the temple's ash tree. Crush it and say the words, and you wake in the nave. Father Osmund swears it's faith. It isn't.

name: a fishing rod
look: A hazel rod with a line of waxed thread, a cork float and a bent iron hook. Fish where there's water: fish.

actions.use: Find some water and type fish. You'll need bait: worms, bread or a ball of bait.

name: a fat worm
look: A fat pink worm, writhing. Fish love them. Nobody else does.

eat.text: You eat the worm. It goes down wriggling. Why did you do that?

name: a ball of bait
look: Bread kneaded with fat and a little blood into a sticky ball. Fish find it hard to resist.

actions.smell: Bread, fat and something worse. Perfect.

name: a minnow
look: A tiny silver fish, barely a mouthful.

eat.text: You eat it raw, bones and all. You've had worse. Not much worse.

name: a roach
look: A silvery river fish with red fins. Bony, but it fills a pot.

eat.text: You eat it raw, bones and all. You've had worse. Not much worse.

name: a perch
look: A striped perch with a spiny back fin, green and gold.

eat.text: You eat it raw, bones and all. You've had worse. Not much worse.

name: a brown trout
look: A brown trout, speckled red and black, still cold from the water.

eat.text: You eat it raw, bones and all. You've had worse. Not much worse.

name: an eel
look: A long brown eel that will not stop moving even now.

eat.text: You eat the eel raw. It does not go quietly.

name: a pike
look: A long green pike with a mouth full of needle teeth and a mean yellow eye. Morda could make something of this.

eat.text: You eat it raw, bones and all. You've had worse. Not much worse.

name: the Grandmother pike
look: A pike as long as you are, ancient, scarred, her jaw hung with the rusted hooks of fifty years of fishermen. Nobody in Gallowmere will believe this. You have to carry her back to show them.

name: an old boot
look: A sodden leather boot. Someone, somewhere, is walking around with one foot wet.

actions.use: You tip out a tiny crab and some weed.

name: a dead rabbit
look: A plump wild rabbit, its neck broken clean. Maud buys meat, and Morda can cook it.

name: a haunch of venison
look: A dark red haunch of deer meat. A feast, if you can get it to a fire.

name: a joint of goat meat
look: Stringy, strong smelling goat. Better in a stew than on its own.

name: a side of boar
look: A side of wild boar, bristles and all. Morda would give a lot to cook this.

name: a fox pelt
look: A red fox pelt, soft as anything, with a white tip to the brush.

actions.touch: So soft. You feel a little bad about it.

name: a wolf pelt
look: A grey wolf pelt, thick for winter, still smelling of the den.

actions.touch: Thick, coarse on top and soft underneath.

name: a bear pelt
look: A great brown bear pelt, heavy as a sack of meal. Tilly would weep. Hook would haggle.

name: a deer hide
look: A fresh deer hide, ready for the tanner. The charcoal burner buys them.

name: a boar's tusk
look: A curved yellow tusk as long as your hand, sharp at the tip.

name: a bear claw
look: A black claw as long as your finger. Proof, if anyone asks.

name: a dry stick
look: A dry stick about as long as your arm. Good for torches and snares.

name: a pitch torch
look: A stick wrapped in oily rags. Light it and it will burn for half an hour.

actions.light: You light the torch. It roars up yellow and pushes the dark back.

name: a rope snare
look: A running noose of rope on a stick peg. Set it on a rabbit run in the Edgewood: set snare.

actions.use: Set it in the Edgewood where the rabbits run: set snare.

name: a pot of campfire stew
look: Whatever you had, boiled over an open fire with a turnip. It's hot. That's the main thing.

eat.text: You eat the stew straight from the pot, burning your mouth. Worth it.

name: a hot pie
look: A great raised pie with a glossy crust, steaming. Morda's best, made with whatever you brought her.

eat.text: You eat the pie in great hot mouthfuls. For a moment, Gallowmere is a good place to live.

name: a cup of rotgut gin
look: Clear as water and twice as dangerous. It smells like a lamp.

drink.text: You knock back the gin. It goes down like a lit fuse and goes off somewhere behind your eyes.

name: a cup of water
look: A cup of well water. Morda charges for it on principle.

drink.text: You drink the water. Clearer headed, a little.

name: a bundle of incense
look: Thin sticks of incense from the shrine, smelling of cedar and smoke.

actions.light: You light the incense. Fragrant smoke curls up, and something in you settles.

name: a fox charm
look: A little carved wooden fox on a red cord, from the shrine. Crush it and the fox takes you back to the shrine: crush charm.

actions.use: Crush it to go back to the shrine: crush charm.

name: a bad fortune
look: A folded paper fortune with the worst news on it. Tie it to the fortune tree to leave the bad luck behind: tie fortune.

actions.read: CURSE. Your aim will waver, your purse will leak. Leave this behind you.

name: a mail shirt
look: Riveted iron rings down to the thigh, heavy and cold. It will turn most blades.

name: a war axe
look: A bearded axe on an ash haft, long enough to need both hands. Hamo's proudest work.

name: a brigand's dirk
look: A long thin dagger with a red wool grip. Brigands wear them in the boot.

name: the captain's blade
look: A long, slightly curved blade of grey steel with a pattern in it like water, too fine for a brigand. Nobody knows where the captain got it, and there is only one.

name: the camp ledger
look: The brigands' accounts, in a cramped hand: takings, shares and buyers.

actions.read: Takings from the road by the week. Shares: the captain, half. Buyers: Hook, always. A note: TOLL STUMP, DON'T STOP THERE AFTER DARK, PAY THE OLD MAN IF HE ASKS. And another: VESNA. NOT YET.

name: a fox fire
look: A little ball of pale blue green light that sits in your palm, cool as a stream. It never goes out.

actions.use: It lights the dark wherever you go, without being lit.

name: a hermit's bell
look: A small bronze hand bell, green with age, with a fish cast on its side.

actions.use: You ring the little bell. Its note goes out across the water and does not seem to stop.

name: a pilgrim's journal
look: A small water stained book in a pilgrim's careful hand.

actions.read: Most of it has run. What's left: '...the old pike that the ferryman calls Grandmother... the white fox that comes only to those who bow properly... the stones sing at the barrow but take nothing from it... the toll man on the road wants only one coin, and remembers who pays...'

name: a gold torc
look: A twisted torc of dull, heavy gold, three thousand years old. It is very cold, always.

actions.touch: Cold, always, as if it were still lying in the dark.

name: a letter of passage
look: A folded sheet in Father Osmund's careful, shaking hand, sealed in grey wax with the Temple of Ash. It swears the bearer is clean of the plague and of the watch's book.

name: a sealed parcel
look: A small parcel in oilcloth, sealed with black wax and Hook's thumbprint. Something inside shifts when you tilt it. Hook said not to open it.

name: a torn parcel
look: Oilcloth and broken black wax, a map of the sewers in a stranger's hand, and a dried rose. Nobody will take it now.
